title: ATTP: a success story and a guarantee of integrity in sport
excerpt: A new organisation in the world of table tennis
body_html:
Following numerous requests from many of you, and from people connected with table tennis who do not yet play in tournaments under the auspices of ATTP but care about the future of the sport, we announce once again that, with the support and accreditation of the Ministry of Education and Research of the Republic of Moldova, the National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players of the Republic of Moldova (ATTP for short) was founded this year.

The founders of this organisation — so important for the present and the successful future of table tennis in Moldova — included the sports company SETKA-PRO, the TOP CUP Association of the Republic of Moldova, coaches and honoured masters, and more than 100 professional and amateur players.

Some of ATTP’s main Objectives are:

a) organising and holding professional and amateur table tennis events at national and international level, including on a commercial basis;

b) popularising professional table tennis and attracting people to the sport, regardless of their age and social status;

c) developing and implementing its own programmes to preserve and apply regional table tennis traditions;

d) establishing and developing relations with other domestic and foreign organisations, institutions and bodies involved in organising sporting events;

e) promoting and applying the principle of fair play in preparing and training athletes, especially young ones; preventing corruption among athletes and fighting match-fixing, manipulation of sports results and the like, including informing the public about the sanctions applied to those who break the law in sport.

We warmly welcome you to the ATTP Team and urge you to respect one another!
